title: Decide and implement unknown capability handling in parse_request
description: RFC 8620 §3.3 requires servers to return unknownCapability for unsupported capabilities. This means any stock JMAP mail client (Thunderbird, etc.) that includes urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail in using will always get a hard rejection from Kith — spec-correct but not interoperable. The design choice is: (A) strict RFC compliance — keep current behavior, reject unknown using entries; (B) pragmatic compatibility — silently ignore unknown using entries, accept the request, only dispatch methods Kith knows about. Option B is a deliberate RFC deviation but allows stock clients to connect without error. A middle path: ignore unknown capabilities but log a warning. Decision must be made explicitly; then implement in parse_request in kith-jmap.
